title: Customer Services Co-ordinator
description: Customer Services Co-ordinator Location: Hatfield based, AL9 5 JN Contract: Full time, Permanent Salary: £29,000 + DOE We are Mulmar, we are growing and we want you! With more than 30 years experience and over 140 employees throughout the UK and Ireland, Mulmar is a leader in the supply and maintenance of some of the world s finest espresso coffee machines in offices, high street coffee shops, restaurants, airports, hotels and food retailers. We are looking to recruit a Customer Services Co-ordinator who will be responsible for liaison customers, responding to reactive maintenance service requirements, planning service calls and logging data into management information system. Key Responsibilities: - Receive incoming enquiries from customers via telephone, fax, email and letter. - Respond to customer service calls: diagnose faults and assist with a telephone fixes where possible, respond directly to customer enquiries, or assign requests to the relevant personnel who can answer, track responses back to the customer to ensure 100% customer satisfaction. - Plan and allocate customer reactive callouts to regional Field Engineers. - Log service requests into the Siclops Service Management System, ensuring that call details are accurate and reflective of call type: Maintain Call monitors, Asset management, Database management and cleansing, Generation of reports - Prioritise, schedule and record service engineer activities. - Monitor and follow up requested information liaise with customers, service team, sales team and other relevant people informed as necessary. - Escalate emerging major issues to Customer Service Supervisor and/or Service Manager. - Ensure Service Desk telephones are promptly answered during working hours. - Check missed calls from previous day. - Ensure services meet customer contracted Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Essential / desirable experience requirements. - Experience in customer services environment working to timescales essential. - Experience of service support in maintenance services, logistics or courier services advantageous but not essential. - Computer literate, preferably with experience in MS Office including Outlook, Word and Excel - Experience in the use of customer databases advantageous. - Good general knowledge of geographical locations within the UK. The job holder should possess the following personal competencies: - Attention to detail. Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about detail. - Customer service skills. Work with customers to assess their needs, provide information, resolve problems with an ability to resolve conflicts or disagreements in a constructive manner. - Communication skills. Be able to express information to customers clearly and concisely, listens to others, understands non-verbal cues and responds appropriately. - Flexibility. Open to change; adapt behaviour or work methods in response to changing conditions, equipment and customer requirements. - Integrity/Honesty. Displays high standards of conduct and is trustworthy. - Interpersonal skills. Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy and politeness to others; able to develop and maintain effective relationships with others. - Resilience. Able to manage pressure, remains optimistic and persistent. If you feel you have the necessary skills and experience to be successful in either of these roles, click on APPLY today, forwarding an up-to-date copy of your CV for consideration in the first instance. No agencies please.

title: Customer service advisor
description: Location: Hemel Hempstead Pay: 12.71 per hour + holiday pay Hours: Monday to Friday, shifts between 9:00am and 6:30pm Start Date: 19th October 2026 Contract: Temp to Perm Are you looking for temp work in Hemel Hempstead and available to start from 19th October 2026? we're looking for three customer service professionals to support Customer Service Advisor project with a fantastic and well-established client of ours. We've placed numerous people with them on temporary projects over the years, and for many it has been a great opportunity to gain office-based experience, whilst for others it's simply been a good way to keep busy and earn some extra money. In this role, you'd typically be taking inbound calls, processing payments and dealing with customer queries, following a straightforward and largely scripted processes. Full training will be provided on how to structure these calls and use their phone and computer system too. The company is PCI compliant, so you won't have any exposure to customers' card information. As part of this role, you'd be working during core hours, Monday to Friday, with shifts such as: 9am to 5pm / 9.30am to 5.30pm / 10am to 6pm / 10.30am to 6.30pm This is an office-based role in the Apsley area of Hemel Hempstead, and remote working isn't an option. With this in mind, you'll need to be able to get to the office each day. Please be aware mobile phones aren't permitted within the Contact Centre and would need to be stored in a designated locker during working hours. This is worth bearing in mind when considering the role. We're initially looking for people who are available for a few weeks of work, although there will likely be opportunities for some people to continue with the company on a longer-term basis too. The role will be weekly paid whilst temping, paying 12.71 per hour + holiday pay accrual. Due to the industry of this company, you'll also be required to undergo a credit check and DBS check. These will be arranged and paid for by an outsourced service provider if you're successfully offered the role, and you'll just need to complete some forms and provide proof of ID and address. We're ideally looking to book short telephone chats/interviews, followed by a few days to a week for the necessary compliance checks. This means we're hoping to have people starting from 19th October 2026. Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment. Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing, and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

The successful candidate will have: - Previous experience in a customer service, or call centre environment. - Strong verbal communication and negotiation skills. - Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure or when dealing with frustrated callers. - Proficient computer skills for navigating databases and updating records.
